record.title: DBA in Project Management (DBAPM) in London 2027
record.longDescription:
The DBA in Project Management is an advanced doctoral-level program designed to develop strategic leaders capable of managing complex projects across global organizations. The course integrates research, leadership, financial management, and strategic analysis to prepare professionals for high-level managerial and academic roles. It focuses on evidence-based decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and innovative project leadership. Graduates will gain the expertise required to drive large-scale projects and strategic initiatives in diverse industries.

This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced project management practices combined with leadership, finance, and strategic management. It emphasizes the application of research methods to solve real-world organizational challenges and improve project outcomes. Through advanced study and applied research, professionals will enhance their ability to plan, execute, and evaluate complex projects. The program prepares learners for executive positions, consultancy roles, and academic research in project management and related disciplines.

Upon completion of the program, students should be able to;

Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.

Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.

Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.

Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.

Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.

Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.

Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.

Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.

Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies.
record.courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods develops skills in research design, data analysis, and academic investigation for organizational problem-solving. Advanced Human Resource Management focuses on strategic workforce planning, talent management, and leadership development within project environments. Strategic Management and Business Analysis explores strategic planning, competitive analysis, and decision-making frameworks used by senior managers. Global Financial Management examines financial planning, risk management, and international financial strategies. Organizational Behaviour studies leadership dynamics, employee motivation, and workplace culture. Advanced Management develops high-level leadership, governance, and managerial decision-making capabilities. Project Management focuses on planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of complex projects across industries.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.
outcomes: Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.
Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.
Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.
Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.
Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.
Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.
Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.
Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.
Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies.

modules.title: GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

blocks.text:
GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.
Global Financial Management Landscape 
Understanding Exchange Rate System 
Understanding International Equity and Debt Markets 
Understanding the Dynamics of Foreign Direct Investment

blocks.text: Entry Requirements

Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in Business and Management Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over five years of managerial and/or business experience Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over eight years of managerial and/or business experience
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.

There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

DBA in Project Management (DBAPM)

The DBA in Project Management is an advanced doctoral-level program designed to develop strategic leaders capable of managing complex projects across global organizations. The course integrates research, leadership, financial management, and strategic analysis to prepare professionals for high-level managerial and academic roles. It focuses on evidence-based decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and innovative project leadership. Graduates will gain the expertise required to drive large-scale projects and strategic initiatives in diverse industries.

This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced project management practices combined with leadership, finance, and strategic management. It emphasizes the application of research methods to solve real-world organizational challenges and improve project outcomes. Through advanced study and applied research, professionals will enhance their ability to plan, execute, and evaluate complex projects. The program prepares learners for executive positions, consultancy roles, and academic research in project management and related disciplines.
Upon completion of the program, students should be able to;
Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.
Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.
Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.
Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.
Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.
Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.
Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.
Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.
Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies.
Course Details
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods develops skills in research design, data analysis, and academic investigation for organizational problem-solving. Advanced Human Resource Management focuses on strategic workforce planning, talent management, and leadership development within project environments. Strategic Management and Business Analysis explores strategic planning, competitive analysis, and decision-making frameworks used by senior managers. Global Financial Management examines financial planning, risk management, and international financial strategies. Organizational Behaviour studies leadership dynamics, employee motivation, and workplace culture. Advanced Management develops high-level leadership, governance, and managerial decision-making capabilities. Project Management focuses on planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of complex projects across industries.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT 5 Lectures 1 Quiz

The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT 18 Lectures 1 Quiz

Project Management focuses on the planning, execution, and successful completion of projects within defined constraints such as time, cost, and scope. It introduces key methodologies, tools, and techniques used to manage projects effectively. The module covers project life cycles, risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder communication. It also emphasizes leadership and teamwork skills essential for managing diverse project environments. By the end, learners will be able to plan, monitor, and deliver projects efficiently and professionally.

modules.title: GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

evidence.text:
DBA in Project Management (DBAPM)
The DBA in Project Management is an advanced doctoral-level program designed to develop strategic leaders capable of managing complex projects across global organizations. The course integrates research, leadership, financial management, and strategic analysis to prepare professionals for high-level managerial and academic roles. It focuses on evidence-based decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and innovative project leadership. Graduates will gain the expertise required to drive large-scale projects and strategic initiatives in diverse industries.
This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced project management practices combined with leadership, finance, and strategic management. It emphasizes the application of research methods to solve real-world organizational challenges and improve project outcomes. Through advanced study and applied research, professionals will enhance their ability to plan, execute, and evaluate complex projects. The program prepares learners for executive positions, consultancy roles, and academic research in project management and related disciplines.
Upon completion of the program, students should be able to;
Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.
Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.
Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.
Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.
Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.
Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.
Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.
Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.
Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies.

The course presents conceptual frameworks and models which will assist students to analyze competitive situations and strategic dilemmas and gaining insight into strategic management. This course will provide a synthesis of previous course materials within the business programmes. Lectures are supplemented with case studies.

Understanding Business Analysis
Strategic Management and Business Analysis Put your knowledge to the test with this quiz. Read each question carefully and choose the response that you feel is correct.
GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT 5 Lectures 1 Quiz
The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.
Global Financial Management Landscape
Understanding Exchange Rate System
Understanding International Equity and Debt Markets
Understanding the Dynamics of Foreign Direct Investment
Country Risk Analysis, International Banking and Trade Finance

Project Management focuses on the planning, execution, and successful completion of projects within defined constraints such as time, cost, and scope. It also emphasizes leadership and teamwork skills essential for managing diverse project environments. By the end, learners will be able to plan, monitor, and deliver projects efficiently and professionally.

evidence.text:
GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.
Global Financial Management Landscape

Entry Requirements
Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in Business and Management Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over five years of managerial and/or business experience Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over eight years of managerial and/or business experience
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:
The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.

The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The DBA in Project Management is an advanced doctoral-level program designed to develop strategic leaders capable of managing complex projects across global organizations. The course integrates research, leadership, financial management, and strategic analysis to prepare professionals for high-level managerial and academic roles. It focuses on evidence-based decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and innovative project leadership. Graduates will gain the expertise required to drive large-scale projects and strategic initiatives in diverse industries.
This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced project management practices combined with leadership, finance, and strategic management. It emphasizes the application of research methods to solve real-world organizational challenges and improve project outcomes. Through advanced study and applied research, professionals will enhance their ability to plan, execute, and evaluate complex projects. The program prepares learners for executive positions, consultancy roles, and academic research in project management and related disciplines.
Upon completion of the program, students should be able to;
Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.
Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.
Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.
Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.
Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.
Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.
Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.
Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.
Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies."},{"contentHash":"0faaea8a2327107724a85bfbe8866cde610c8812d7f26496791bb0981448d905","courseSlug":"dba-in-project-management","heading":"courseDetails","id":"chunk-6d2defabbcb3d82227d09a12","items":[{"text":"Course Details","type":"h4"},{"text":"The course is delivered in two segments.
